guarantee_a: A stop request is visible before a new trade read. The check and fetch_all_trades_ordered share _pg_lock, so a stop that wins the lock prevents the query.
guarantee_b: A query that already passed the check holds _pg_lock until it finishes. release_connection_after_failed_startup waits for that lock.
timed_out_worker: It remains tracked and cannot begin a trade read. A composed release after a blocked lifespan produced no query and no new connection.
application_compatibility: app.py ignores the status and does not raise on timeout. On the reachable success path it retains the process connection. On the reachable failure path Telegram has not started.
limitations: Startup failure after Telegram start is not reachable in current app.py.
A future edit that released the database during an incomplete stop would depend on this Telegram gate. app.py itself still does not read the status.
